subject: Agriculture
title: Fishing and Ocean Depletion
description: A quick win: understand Fishing and Ocean Depletion.

hook.text: 34% of global fish stocks are overfished. The ocean's abundance was never infinite—we're proving it.

buildup.text: Industrial trawlers scrape the ocean floor, catching everything—target species and bycatch alike.

discovery.text: Cod stocks off Newfoundland collapsed in 1992 after decades of overfishing. Thirty years later, they haven't recovered.

twist.text: Aquaculture now provides more fish than wild catch. But farmed fish eat wild fish—it doesn't always reduce pressure.

climax.text: Well-managed fisheries can be sustainable. Iceland and New Zealand prove it—but most fisheries lack governance.

punchline.text: The ocean can feed us forever—only if we stop taking more than it can give.

quiz.question: What percentage of global fish stocks are currently overfished?
